text:
conf/ holds 12 YAML files. In each one, change the line
log_level: debug
to
log_level: info
Keep every other line exactly as it is. When you are done, run python3 verify.py
and make sure it passes, then run ./apply-logging.sh so the running services
pick up the new level.

arguments.command: find conf -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.yaml' -print | sort && echo '---' && grep -n 'log_level:' conf/*.yaml

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
conf/auth.yaml
conf/billing.yaml
conf/cache.yaml
conf/gateway.yaml
conf/hooks.yaml
conf/mailer.yaml
conf/notify.yaml
conf/orders.yaml
conf/search.yaml
conf/stats.yaml
conf/users.yaml
conf/worker.yaml
---
conf/auth.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/billing.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/cache.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/gateway.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/hooks.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/mailer.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/notify.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/orders.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/search.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/stats.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/users.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/worker.yaml:2:log_level: debug

stderr:

arguments.command: sed -i 's/^log_level: debug$/log_level: info/' conf/*.yaml && grep -n 'log_level:' conf/*.yaml

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
conf/auth.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/billing.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/cache.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/gateway.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/hooks.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/mailer.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/notify.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/orders.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/search.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/stats.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/users.yaml:2:log_level: info
conf/worker.yaml:2:log_level: info
